BeginDueNotificationDeliveryRead.reason: Shares the due query with the legacy NotificationDeliveries reader. Channel and terminal-failure filters apply before the 1000-row limit. The bounded reader preserves installed physical/default lookup and logical SQL key, including source-first missing errors and an atomic default re-selection after independent admission. It clears borrowed source headers, byte-gates flat typed SQL rows before decoding and retains detached output under a separate 64 MiB allowance through Close. Tests cover ordinary/resident results, malformed rows, source replacement, parent release, cancellation, row and argument budgets, default switching and the 1000-row boundary.
